integrity: Exact analytic proof for all real positive shapes and every pair of quantiles; finite numerical checker is supplementary. Prior decreasing variance is explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the exponentiated log-exponential family; continuous shape is not a literal sample count; does not order finite coupon-collector times. An inaccessible 2026 paper and 2021 order-statistics paper remain historical-priority risks.
title: Strict dispersive contraction for logarithms of exponential sample maxima
